---
title: "Examples"
---

Each page picks one capability, frames it as a problem you've hit, and links to a self-contained `docs/examples/*.py` file you can drop into your hooks directory. Every example ships with inline `tests = {...}` you can run with `uvx capt-hook --hooks docs/examples test`. The pages read thin in source because the code is injected from the `.py` file at build time.

Work through them by job, from guarding against mistakes to composing a full hooks file.

## Threat modeling

Stop dangerous actions before they run.

| Example | Teaches |
|---|---|
| [Command Safety](command-safety.qmd) | `block_command` plus command-line AST predicates |
| [Deploy & Secret Guard](deploy-secret-guard.qmd) | block infra-destroying commands and secret leaks |
| [Audit Logging](audit.qmd) | a JSONL trail of every tool call |

## Feedback

Drive the agent with the right nudge at the right time.

| Example | Teaches |
|---|---|
| [Code Quality](code-quality.qmd) | layered detection: regex `hook`, AST `lint`, signal `nudge`, `llm_gate` |
| [Failure Recovery](failure-recovery.qmd) | a signal-driven `Stop` nudge when failures repeat |
| [LLM Cost Control](llm-cost-control.qmd) | bound an LLM hook's token spend |

## Workflow

Enforce process across a session.

| Example | Teaches |
|---|---|
| [Settings Config](settings-config.qmd) | a `HooksSettings` subclass read by a sibling hook |
| [Session Workflow](session-workflow.qmd) | `@workflow_state` spanning several events |
| [Multi-Step Workflow](multi-step-workflow.qmd) | `workflow` / `Step` / `Artifact` before `SubagentStop` |
